slot_scores.name: purchase_beginning_of_month_timing
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Can you purchase and sell in the same month, and if so, is there any limit on how many units can be purchased or sold in a single month?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent asked whether purchase and sale can occur in the same month, which touches the timing/availability issue, but did not explicitly ask whether purchases occur at the beginning of the month or whether purchased goods are immediately available for sale in that same month.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Purchases occur at the beginning of each month and purchased units are available for sale in the same month.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent did not explicitly confirm the beginning-of-month purchase timing; it only asked whether purchase and sale can occur in the same month, then assumed same-month availability in the inventory balance and objective.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL while the P1 hidden slot about beginning-of-month purchase timing was only partially addressed and not explicitly confirmed.

summary: The agent clarified several important modeling details, including warehouse timing, same-month buying/selling, demand limits, ending stock, integrality, and profit definition, but it only partially covered the beginning-of-month purchase timing and then silently assumed same-month availability in its final model.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
